newsitem.title: USA: Forcenergy files for up to 3.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Forcenergy files for up to 3.5 mln shares.

text.p: Forcenergy Inc said on Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange to issue up to 3.5 million common shares.

The Miami-based company said of the total, it is selling 1,537,958 shares, while 1,962,042 common shares are being offered by selling shareholders. The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option of up to 525,000 additional common shares.
Concurrently with the stock offer, the company is offering $175 million in senior subordinated notes due 2006, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Howard, Weil, Labouisse Friedrichs Inc and Prudential Securites Inc.

Proceeds will be used to repay a portion of National Data's debt under its senior credit facility. The company may reborrow amounts under the facility to fund its continuing capital expenditure program and other general corporate purposes.
